$comment: Read by scripts/verify-test-inventory.js. 'indirect': a test that a runner script (itself run by a workflow) starts; the runner must name the file. 'excluded': a test file or pattern no workflow runs, with the reason. Entries that match nothing, or exclude a test a workflow runs, fail the verifier. Remove an exclusion when its test is wired into a workflow. Test files are those named like tests (see TEST_NAME in the verifier); verifiers such as scripts/verify-*.js are outside the inventory.

excluded.reason: third-party npm packages (node-gyp, pump, retry) vendored into the firmware payload; their own test files are not OSI tests. The bcm2709 copies fall under the mirror pattern below

byte-identical mirror of the bcm2712 node-red tree: scripts/verify-profile-parity.js hashes the whole tree (run by codecs.yml, field-journal.yml and verify-sync-flow.js), and CI runs both profiles on the same Node, so a second run tests the same bytes. Mirror copies run only where a test reads sibling packages of its own profile (osi-module-defaults, migrations.yml) or already ran before this inventory (osi-journal, field-journal.yml)
